questions.text: «I was wondering if you could help» — nega o'tgan zamon?
questions.explanation: C1 da zamon uslubiy effekt uchun tanlanadi: masofa = muloyimlik yoki noreallik.

questions.text: «So he walks in and says...» — bu qanday hodisa?
questions.explanation: O'tmish voqeasini hozirgi zamonda aytish ta'sirchanlikni oshiradi.
Present Continuous + always/keep — hissiy shikoyat.

questions.text: «You're being silly» — nega stative fe'l Continuous da?
questions.explanation: «I'm loving it» ham shu qolipda — vaqtinchalik holat.

questions.text: «Oil will float on water» — «will» bu yerda nima?
questions.explanation: He'll sit for hours — takroriy xulq-atvor.

questions.text: «Under no circumstances ___ you enter» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: Inkor ibora boshda → yordamchi + ega + fe'l.

questions.text: «No sooner had he left ___ the phone rang» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: No sooner ... THAN; Hardly/Scarcely ... WHEN.

options: TUSHADI: Had I known / Were I you / Should you need
questions.explanation: Inkorda qisqarmaydi: Had I NOT known.

questions.text: «Not only» dan keyin odatda nima keladi?
questions.explanation: Not only did he arrive late, but he also forgot the documents.
Such + (a) + ot + was... ham shu qolipda.
Bitta gap bo'linadi va bir element ta'kidlanadi.
Odam → who/that; narsa → that/which; vaqt/joy/sabab → that.

questions.text: «What he did was ___ call» — bo'shliqqa nima?
questions.explanation: Wh-cleftda harakat fokusi (to) + V1 shaklida beriladi.

questions.text: «All I want is...» — bu qanday cleft?
questions.explanation: All you have to do is ask. All it takes is...

questions.text: «A holiday is what I need» — bu qanday shakl?
questions.explanation: What I need is a holiday — teskari tartibda ham to'g'ri.

questions.text: «I insist that he ___ present» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: Mandative subjunctive: that + ega + V1 (asos shakl).
Passivda: that it BE DONE / BE SUBMITTED.
It's (high) time + Past; I'd rather you DIDN'T.
«lest» arxaik-rasmiy bog'lovchi, subjunctive talab qiladi.

questions.text: «Be that as it may» — bu qanday shakl?
questions.explanation: Come what may, If need be, Suffice it to say, So be it.

questions.text: «If I had slept, I wouldn't be tired now» — bu qanday shart?
questions.explanation: Teskarisi: If I weren't shy, I would have asked (hozir → o'tmish).

questions.text: «Had it not been for...» nimaga teng?
options: If it had not been for
questions.explanation: Inverted conditional — rasmiy uslub.
Implied conditional: Without X, Otherwise, Given X.

questions.text: «Were I to accept» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: Were I to... — rasmiy kelajak faraz shakli.

questions.text: «in the event that» qaysi registrga tegishli?
questions.explanation: Supposing/Say — og'zaki muqobillar.

options: Da'voni yumshatish — mutlaq emas, ehtiyotkor qilish
questions.explanation: Akademik va professional yozuvning yuragi.
Qattiq → yumshoq: everyone→many, will→is likely to, is→may be.

questions.text: «It could be argued that...» qanday vosita?
questions.explanation: It seems/appears that, It is likely that, It would seem.
all→most/many; always→tend to/usually.
probably, possibly, generally, to some extent, relatively.
very big→enormous, very happy→delighted, very angry→furious.

questions.text: «absolutely, utterly, completely» qaysi sifatlar bilan keladi?
questions.explanation: «very enormous» xato; «absolutely enormous» to'g'ri.
Kuchli kollokatsiyalar: deeply concerned, highly likely, bitterly disappointed.
Kollokatsiya juftlik sifatida yodlanadi — mantiq bilan chiqarilmaydi.

questions.text: Aniq so'z tanlash IELTS ning qaysi mezoniga tegishli?
questions.explanation: Band 8 uchun «very + oddiy» o'rniga bitta aniq so'z talab qilinadi.
conduct research, draw a conclusion, pose a threat, play a role.
make = yaratish; do = faoliyat (do research/homework/business).
strong coffee/accent, deep sleep, high hopes.
address an issue, have an impact, take into account — akademik bloklar.
bear fruit, a foregone conclusion, vested interest — kuchli iboralar.
Idiom so'zma-so'z tarjima qilinmaydi — qotib qolgan ko'chma ma'no.

questions.text: «as cool as a cucumber» qanday idiom turi?
questions.explanation: Turlar: pure (spill the beans), metaforik (break the ice), simile, binomial, proverb.

questions.text: «cost an arm and a leg» qaysi mavzuga tegishli?
questions.explanation: in the nick of time (vaqt), over the moon (his), see eye to eye (munosabat).

options: Academic Writing Task 1 va rasmiy hisobot
questions.explanation: Writing Task 2 da faqat mavhum idiomlar (a double-edged sword) o'rinli.

questions.text: «a slice of cake» deb aytish mumkinmi?
questions.explanation: Idiomni buzmang va so'zma-so'z tarjima qilmang (my heart sank — «fell» emas).
Separable: turn IT on; inseparable/three-word: look after IT.

questions.text: Akademik matnda «find out» o'rniga nima ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: put off→postpone, look into→investigate — rasmiy lotincha muqobillar.
To'ldiruvchi olmaydi: The car broke down.
Band 9 — registrga qarab to'g'ri tanlash: og'zaki → phrasal, akademik → lotincha.

options: Separable phrasal verbda olmosh o'rtada bo'ladi: turn it on
questions.explanation: Bu qoida faqat olmoshga tegishli; ot ikkala joyda kelishi mumkin.
